### B. ALEKS Insights

| Alert Category | Description | Specific Numbers |
|----------------|-------------|-----------------|
| Not Succeeding | Student struggling from the start | No fixed numeric threshold disclosed; ML-based |

| Rule | Specific Value |
|------|---------------|

| Feature used in engagement detector | Proportion of actions where student took **>80 seconds** to respond |
